maker_help_method.message: Choose a method to read a selected element or transform its value.

maker_help_search_url.message: This is the address the extension uses for future searches.

maker_help_search_method.message: Choose the HTTP method used by the tracker’s search form.

maker_help_search_encoding.message: Choose the character encoding that the tracker expects for the search query.

maker_help_search_charset.message: Set the response encoding if the page’s text is unreadable.

maker_help_search_body.message: Enter the data sent in the POST request body.

maker_help_search_query.message: Enter any parameters that need to be added to the request address.

maker_help_search_baseUrl.message: This field preserves the base URL saved in older tracker definitions.

maker_help_search_originUrl.message: This is the page opened for requests through a tab.

maker_help_search_headers.message: Enter extra HTTP headers as a JSON object.

maker_help_search_tab.message: Run requests from a tab on the tracker’s site.

maker_help_check_phrase.message: Enter a query to test the current tracker settings.

maker_help_selector_row.message: Select the repeated element that contains one result.

maker_help_login_url.message: Enter the address of the tracker’s sign-in page.

maker_help_desc_name.message: Enter a name users will recognize in tracker lists.

maker_help_desc_description.message: Write a short description of what people can find on this tracker.

maker_help_desc_version.message: Set the version of the tracker definition.

maker_help_icon.message: Use a hex color or an image for this tracker’s icon.

maker_help_code_url.message: Enter a direct HTTP or HTTPS link to the tracker’s JSON file.

maker_help_json.message: Paste the contents of a tracker JSON file exported from the builder.

maker_source_invalid.message: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS address.

maker_help_address_usage.message: Automatic setup uses this page to find the result fields and the place to substitute the search query.

maker_help_phrase_usage.message: The extension uses the complete phrase to work out where future queries go.

maker_help_search_url_usage.message: Put %search% where the search phrase belongs. The request can also take the phrase from the query parameters or POST body.

maker_help_search_method_usage.message: GET sends parameters in the address. For POST, fill in the request body if the form sends data there.

maker_help_search_encoding_usage.message: The extension encodes the query before substituting %search%. Most sites use UTF-8. Some older sites expect Windows-1251.

maker_help_search_charset_usage.message: Leave it empty to use the response headers. The extension falls back to UTF-8.

maker_help_search_body_usage.message: Use %search% for the query. If the body is JSON, set Content-Type in HTTP headers.

maker_help_search_query_usage.message: The extension adds the separator and substitutes %search%. Enter each parameter once across the address and this field.

maker_help_search_baseUrl_usage.message: The extension resolves relative links using the actual response address. Leave this field empty when setting up a new tracker.

maker_help_search_originUrl_usage.message: Use the page that should provide the tracker session. Leave it empty to use the request’s origin.

maker_help_search_headers_usage.message: Put header names and values in double quotes. Include headers that the tracker needs for this request.

maker_help_search_tab_usage.message: The browser can use the site session from the tab. Turn this on if the tracker only shows results after you sign in there.

maker_help_check_phrase_usage.message: Try a second query to make sure both the request and the results change.

maker_help_selector_row_usage.message: The extension looks for the title, link and other fields inside each matching result row.

maker_help_selector_title.message: Select the element that contains the result’s title.

maker_help_selector_title_usage.message: Read its text inside each result row. A result needs a title to appear in search.

maker_help_selector_url.message: Select the link that opens the result’s details.

maker_help_selector_url_usage.message: Read href to get the address. Results need a details link to appear in search.

maker_help_selector_size.message: Select the element that contains the result’s size.

maker_help_selector_size_usage.message: The finished value is in bytes. Use parseSize for text such as 1.5 GB.

maker_help_selector_downloadUrl.message: Select the direct download link for the result.

maker_help_selector_downloadUrl_usage.message: Read href. Leave the field empty if the results page has no download link.

maker_help_selector_seeds.message: Select the element that contains the seed count.

maker_help_selector_seeds_usage.message: Return a whole number. Remove any label with a transformation before converting the value.

maker_help_selector_peers.message: Select the leecher count as displayed by the tracker.

maker_help_selector_peers_usage.message: Use the element with the right counter and return a whole number for each result.

maker_help_selector_date_usage.message: Choose a transformation that matches the site’s date format. For an ISO date in datetime, read the attribute and use parseIsoDate.

maker_help_selector_nextPageUrl.message: Select the link to the next results page.

maker_help_selector_nextPageUrl_usage.message: The extension looks for the link across the entire page. If it finds no match, it stops loading results.

maker_help_selector_categoryTitle.message: Select the category name shown for the result.

maker_help_selector_categoryTitle_usage.message: Read the category text. Add a category link separately if the name is clickable on the tracker.

maker_help_selector_categoryUrl.message: Select the link to the result’s category.

maker_help_selector_categoryUrl_usage.message: Read href from the category link. If the field is empty, the category name still appears as text.

maker_help_selector_loginForm.message: Select a form or other element that identifies the sign-in page.

maker_help_selector_loginForm_usage.message: The extension prompts users to sign in when the selector matches. Choose an element that appears only when sign-in is required.

maker_help_skipFromStart.message: Enter how many matching rows to skip at the start.

maker_help_skipFromStart_usage.message: Use 1 to skip a matching table header. Use 0 if the selector only finds result rows.

maker_help_skipFromEnd.message: Enter how many matching rows to skip at the end.

maker_help_skipFromEnd_usage.message: Use 1 to skip a matching navigation row. Use 0 if the selector only finds result rows.

maker_help_desc_url_usage.message: Users can visit this address from the tracker’s site icon.

maker_help_desc_version_usage.message: Increase the version when you replace a published JSON file, so the extension can detect the update.

maker_help_icon_usage.message: The file and URL buttons embed the image in the exported tracker. They support PNG, JPEG, SVG and ICO.

maker_help_code_url_usage.message: The extension uses this address to install and update the tracker. Leave it empty for a local draft.

maker_help_export.message: This is the JSON generated from the current draft after a successful check.

maker_help_export_usage.message: Copy or download the code to publish it or open it later with Import JSON.

maker_help_method_usage.message: Steps run in order. Each step receives the previous step’s result. Open help next to an argument for the format expected by that method.

maker_help_argument_Attribute.message: Enter the name of an HTML attribute on the selected element.

maker_help_argument_Attribute_usage.message: getAttr reads the value as written in the HTML. An href attribute can contain a relative path.

maker_help_argument_Property.message: Enter the name of a DOM property on the selected element.

maker_help_argument_Property_usage.message: For a link, the href property returns the resolved address. textContent returns its text.

maker_help_argument_Index.message: Enter the index of the child node to select.

maker_help_argument_Index_usage.message: Use 0 for the first node or -1 for the last. Text nodes are included in the count.

maker_help_argument_PatternText.message: Enter the exact text to replace.

maker_help_argument_PatternText_usage.message: replace matches the first occurrence and is case-sensitive. Spaces and punctuation are part of the text.

maker_help_argument_PatternRegex.message: Enter a regular expression to find text to replace.

maker_help_argument_PatternRegex_usage.message: Enter only the pattern, without surrounding slashes or flags. replaceRe finds all matches and ignores case.

maker_help_argument_ReplaceTo.message: Enter the text to insert at each match.

maker_help_argument_ReplaceTo_usage.message: Leave this field empty to remove matching text.

maker_help_argument_Format.message: Enter a pattern that describes the date text on the tracker.

maker_help_argument_Format_usage.message: Use DD for the day, MM for the month and YYYY for the year. Include the separators used on the site.

maker_help_argument_Template.message: Select the date template that matches the tracker’s text.

maker_help_argument_Template_usage.message: Compare the order of the day, month and year, or select a relative time template.

maker_argument_invalid_regex.message: Enter a valid regular expression without surrounding slashes.

maker_argument_invalid_string.message: Enter a value in the format shown in the help.

maker_argument_invalid_select.message: Select a template from the list.

maker_check_request_unverified.message: These results came from the supplied page. Run a check with the current request before exporting.

maker_check_other_page.message: Another checked page has errors that block export.

maker_check_origin.message: The request address or tab origin is outside the tracker’s allowed origins.

maker_help_desc_name_usage.message: This is the name users see when they select trackers for a search.

maker_help_desc_description_usage.message: Mention the kind of content people can find on this tracker.

maker_help_login_url_usage.message: The extension offers this link if the login selector matches a response.

maker_help_json_usage.message: Import replaces the draft. You can review or check its settings before generating a new JSON file.
